backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor implementing a time-tracking backend with persistent storage for time entries, journal entries, daily media, user profiles, and files, plus access control initialization and role management.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two implemented features (welcome dialog and Android Chrome removeChild crash fix) to their relevant source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated summary index describing the purpose and key details of each frontend source file in the project.
frontend/ANDROID_REGRESSION_CHECKLIST.md: Manual QA checklist for verifying Android Chrome stability, covering bottom nav taps, header buttons, rapid interactions, console error checks, and admin publish dialog behavior on a production build.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that sets viewport meta tags, titles the app in French, and mounts the React app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/PRODUCTION_BUILD_RUNBOOK.md: Step-by-step runbook for building and verifying a production-minified frontend bundle before publishing, listing prerequisites and build commands.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing authentication state, session-scoped WelcomeDialog, tab-based page routing (dashboard/calendar/journal/reports), profile setup dialog, and mobile bottom navigation.
frontend/src/components/DayTypeCheckboxG: Reusable mutually exclusive checkbox group component for selecting a day type (Travail/Congé/Astreinte) with visual active-state styling and check icons.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary component that catches runtime errors and displays a fallback UI with reload/go-back options, with special handling for Android Chrome removeChild DOMExceptions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying a copyright notice and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: App header with the TimeTrack logo, version badge, Internet Identity login/logout button, and an admin-only PublishRetryDialog trigger.
Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile screens with four tabs (Dashboard, Calendar, Journal, Reports) using debounced safe-tap handlers.
frontend/src/components/PublishRetryDial: Admin dialog that requires confirming an Android regression checklist before triggering a publish workflow restart via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/WelcomeDialog.ts: Modal welcome dialog shown to new users introducing TimeTracker features, with a 'Get Started' button to dismiss it.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) via React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY AuthClient login/logout state and persisting identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for CRUD operations on time entries, journal entries, user profiles, daily media, and reporting, all backed by an ICP actor. Each mutation invalidates relevant query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSafeTap.ts: Custom hook that wraps async event handlers with debounce and concurrency lock to prevent double-tap issues and Android Chrome DOM removeChild crashes by deferring execution to the next animation frame.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining light/dark CSS custom properties for the design system, mobile-safe layout utilities, and component styles to prevent tap/overflow issues on mobile browsers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for ICP authentication wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Calendar.tsx: Monthly calendar page allowing authenticated users to view, create, edit, and delete time entries per day, with a dialog form supporting work hours, day types, meal/travel time, and intervention slots.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page displaying aggregated time-tracking statistics (hours, day types, vacation, on-call) with bar and pie charts, filterable by weekly, monthly, or yearly periods using selectable date ranges.
frontend/src/pages/Journal.tsx: Journal page enabling users to create and manage daily journal entries with audio recording, manual transcription, notes, photo uploads, and day-type tagging via a dialog form.
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: React page component for viewing and exporting time entry reports, supporting filtering by week or month with totals for normal, astreinte, and intervention hours, plus PDF export functionality.
frontend/src/utils/buildInfo.ts: Utility that exposes build metadata (mode and optional timestamp) sourced from Vite environment variables.
frontend/src/utils/debugLogging.ts: Development-only debug logging utility with a circular in-memory buffer for UI interaction history, controllable via localStorage flag.
frontend/src/utils/weekOptions.ts: Utility functions for computing ISO week numbers, week start/end dates, and generating labeled week options for a given month and year.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, box shadow, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking existing features, known issues, and pending feature requests for the Heures Tracker application.
